purpose: Validation-only v3.3 continuation pilot. Increase the contralateral high-frequency loss from the balanced v3.2 checkpoint while retaining the dual-sampling strict-HRIR ILD objective.
split_policy: train and locked validation only; no test export or read

selection_protocol.stage_1: On the fixed validation sampler, retain a candidate only when contralateral high-frequency error does not regress versus its v3.2 ILD=0.75 initialization and neither ERB nor strict ILD regresses by more than 0.5 percent.
selection_protocol.stage_2: Only eligible candidates receive 44-subject strict MATLAB reconstruction on validation. Test remains sealed until a user explicitly selects one final model.

strict_validation_results.decision: Reject both candidates: their sub-0.03 percent high-frequency gains versus v3 do not offset ERB regressions, and neither improves on the balanced v3.2 ILD=0.75 candidate.
